subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat add a message-level long-press action surface, and should the first approved scope include Share and Reply or only Copy and Select Copy?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested behavior, but adding new Android message actions and reply semantics is a product/UX choice; the only linked open implementation is conflicting and not ready to land as-is.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Implement a narrow long-press sheet for full-message copy and selective copy, preserving link taps and scroll behavior, and defer Share/Reply unless separately approved.

options.title: Adopt the full linked action set
options.body: Refresh or replace the linked fork PR with Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply after fixing conflicts and proving reply semantics reach the composer/model correctly.

options.title: Defer Android message actions
options.body: Keep code-block-only selection for now and close or defer the linked implementation attempts as outside current Android UX scope.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow long-press sheet for full-message copy and selective copy, preserving link taps and scroll behavior, and defer Share/Reply unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and the strongest recent routing signal for the Android chat surface in this checkout.
